cases.name: Anna Smith Brown
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative: When officers entered the residence, they found Anna Brown unconscious with no pulse. She was reportedly holding a steak knife and had visible bruising on the left side of her neck. Law enforcement began CPR at the scene before she was transported to Kittitas Valley Hospital. She was later airlifted to Harborview Medical Center for further evaluation, where she ultimately died.
